entities.summary: Clara Corral Aller was a Galician poet, the second woman to publish a text in Galician language during the 19th century, after Rosalía de Castro. Daughter of Dimas Corral Rebellón and Clara Aller Presas, in 1852 she moved with her family to Lugo. Orphaned by her father and mother, she moved with her sisters Consuelo and Rita to Santiago de Compostela in 1868 and devoted herself to her literary work. Their poems appeared in the press of the time, El Diario de Santiago, Revista Compostelana de Instrucción y Recreo and La Ilustración Gallega y Asturiana.
